purpose: Front and rear wing reconstruction detail passes; September pilot configurations, not November race upgrades

references.observation: Complete detached front assembly: swept flap outlines, exposed slot brackets, high narrow endplates with curled upper edge, contoured outboard foot. Exact sections and slot dimensions are estimates.
Rear mainplane has a shallow central bowl and visible central actuator fairing. Supports are partly obscured; dimensions and concealed mechanism remain unresolved.
Rear assembly: central bowl, narrow paired supports, inward-tapered lower endplates and exposed upper flap edges. Exact profiles and actuation internals unresolved.
On-track front three-quarter: broad upper-flap silhouette, outboard transition and endplate outline; rear silhouette provides a secondary check.

limitations: Numerical stations are authored exterior estimates, not measured factory dimensions.
Paddock photographs do not alone prove race fitment; September track photographs provide configuration cross-checks.
No aerodynamic performance or regulatory compliance certification.
Other constructors retain their existing wing silhouettes unless separately reviewed.
